patient.Description: Patient label identifying them as being from adult (HUP) or pediatric (CHOP) center

iEEG_ID.Description: File name on the cloud storage system iEEG.org

approximate_onset.Description: Reference time that clinicians had for approximately when the seizure started relative to implant

end.Description: Reference time for when the seizure ended relative to implant

clinician.Description: List containing three to five entries identifying the clinician(s) doing the annotation

stim.Description: Indicates whether the seizure was induced by electrical stimulation or spontaneously occurring
stim.Notes: The HUP249 seizure at approximate_onset = 439029.32 s was induced by a separate high-frequency stimulation protocol (not the low-frequency CCEP protocol used for the other stim-induced seizures). Its stim_frequency, stim_amplitude, and stim_pulse_width are therefore left blank because those parameters are unknown.

stim_channels.Description: Channels where electrical stimulation was delivered (for stim-induced seizures)

stim_frequency.Description: Frequency of the electrical stimulation pulse train used to induce the seizure (blank for spontaneous seizures or when unknown)

stim_amplitude.Description: Current amplitude of the electrical stimulation used to induce the seizure (blank for spontaneous seizures or when unknown)

stim_pulse_width.Description: Pulse width of each biphasic stimulation pulse used to induce the seizure (blank for spontaneous seizures or when unknown)

ueo_time.Description: List containing three to five entries with the time in the file each clinician marked as ueo (unequivocal electrographic onset)

ueo_time_consensus.Description: Consensus ueo time via median of individual clinician annotations

ueo.Description: List containing three to five entries with the channels each clinician marked as seizing at onset

ueo_consensus.Description: Consensus channels marked as seizing at onset via majority voting of individual clinician annotations

sec.Description: List containing three to five entries with the channels each clinician marked as seizing 10 seconds after their determined onset time

sec_consensus.Description: Consensus channels marked as seizing 10 seconds after onset via majority voting of individual clinician annotations

semiology.Description: Label for stim seizures indicating if the stim seizure reproduced that patient's habitual spontaneous seizure semiology

Levels.Typical: stim seizure reproduced habitual spontaneous seizure semiology
Levels.Atypical: stim seizure did not reproduce habitual spontaneous seizure semiology
Levels.Unknown: semiology classification unavailable or seizure was spontaneous

run.Description: BIDS run number for cloud storage file

lvfa.Description: Whether low-voltage fast activity (LVFA) was present at electrographic onset, determined by visual review (EC) of the raw iEEG.

Levels.yes: seizure onset showed low-voltage fast activity
Levels.no: seizure onset did not show low-voltage fast activity
